name: CSS Vigil
note: R13.30, Captain's Module R4 SSD p.70 (PDF p.71). The Destroyer's hull turned carrier: turn mode B, size class 4, movement cost 1/2, C hull 10, warp 8 a side, impulse 2, APR 2, bridge 2, emergency 1, aux 1, transporters 2, tractors 2, one probe, shields 20 all round, excess damage 4, and the DD's damage tracks exactly. WHAT THE BAY COST: two batteries and two labs - TWO each here against the DD's four of each. The CE, converting the Light Cruiser to an ESCORT, pays nothing in power; the CVL and this ship, converting to CARRIERS, both pay. Two conversions of two hulls and the same rule falls out, which is only visible because the siblings were entered first. Crew 30 against the DD's 24, boarding parties 6 against 8, and EIGHT DECK CREWS for eight fighters. THE BAY: twelve SHUTTLE boxes, four plain and eight marked, against an administrative shuttles table listing four and the owner's complement of 7 superiority and 1 EW - eight and eight. Two balcony positions (J1.53). ARMAMENT is the DD's shape: two plasma-F at FP (A and B, with pseudos listed for both) and two rear-firing plasma-F arriving with the PL-F refit, C to port and D to starboard, flagged iscRearFiring under R13.1C, which the sheet cites by name. POINT VALUE = 100/90 ON THE SHEET, and the owner read it 2026-10-23: the SMALLER number is the BPV and the larger is the EPV. So 90 less the 4 for going without PL-F gives 86 here, with the economic value recorded beside it. THE EPV TAKES THE SAME DEDUCTION AS THE BPV: 100 less 4 gives 96, as 90 less 4 gives 86. The owner ruled it 2026-10-23, and the rule was ALREADY IN THE CODEBASE - RefitResolver carries an owner ruling from 2026-10-11 that an upgrade applies its points to BOTH values, and does out.epv += r.bpv automatically. An earlier draft of this note called the undeducted EPV an assumption rather than looking for the answer, which had been sitting in a javadoc the whole time. The refit needs no epv of its own; the engine adds the bpv delta. Every other ISC carrier gives a single point value, so this is the first ISC hull in the game to carry an epv at all. The Y180 Sabot refit (+6) is absent as elsewhere: FP11.0 is in Module R10, out of scope.

refits.name: PL-F refit
refits.label: Plasma-F
refits._note: Sheet: WITHOUT THE PL-F REFIT, DELETE PLASMA-F TORPEDOES 'C' AND 'D'. Named designators, as on the Destroyer, because A and B are base armament and only these two are the refit. R13.1C's rear-firing torpedoes, cited by name on this sheet, and the pseudo-plasma box lists pseudos for A and B alone - which is R13.1C's 'no PPTs' drawn rather than written. No epv is set here: see the hull note on why the economic value is left as printed.
